title: Harnessing Natural Product Compounds to Target Dormancy Survival Regulator (DosR) in Latent Tuberculosis Infection (LTBI): An In Silico Strategy Against Dormancy.
authors: Chouhan, Mandeep; Kumar, Mukesh; Dwivedi, Vivek Dhar; Kashyap, Vivek Kumar; Singh, Himanshu Narayan; Kumar, Sanjay
one_liner_zh: 该文针对结核分枝杆菌休眠调控蛋白DosR进行天然产物虚拟筛选与分子动力学模拟，属于小分子-蛋白对接，而非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究无关。
abstract: Dormancy occurs when Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) enters a non-replicating and metabolically inactive state in response to hostile environment. During this state, it is highly resistant to conventional antibiotics, which increase the urgency to develop new potential drugs against dormant bacilli. In view of this, the dormancy survival regulator (DosR) protein is thought to be an essential component that plays a key role in bacterial adaptation to dormancy during hypoxic conditions. Herein, the NP-lib database containing natural product compounds was screened virtually against the binding site of the DosR protein using the MTiopen screen web server. A series of computational analyses were performed, including redocking, intermolecular interaction analysis, and MDS, followed by binding free energy analysis. Through screening, 1000 natural product compounds were obtained with docking energy ranging from -8.5 to -4.1 kcal/mol. The top four lead compounds were then selected for further investigation. On comparative analysis of intermolecular interaction, dynamics simulation and MM/GBSA calculation revealed that M3 docked with the DosR protein (docking score = -8.1 kcal/mol, RMSD = ~7 A and DeltaG Bind = -53.51 kcal/mol) exhibited stronger stability than reference compound Ursolic acid (docking score = -6.2 kcal/mol, RMSD = ~13.5 A and DeltaG Bind = -44.51 kcal/mol). Hence, M3 is recommended for further validation through in vitro and in vivo studies against latent tuberculosis infection.
abstract_zh: 休眠发生在结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Mtb）响应不利环境而进入非复制和代谢不活跃状态时。在此状态下，它对常规抗生素高度耐药，这增加了开发针对休眠杆菌的新潜在药物的紧迫性。鉴于此，休眠生存调节因子（DosR）蛋白被认为是在低氧条件下细菌适应休眠过程中起关键作用的重要组分。本文中，使用MTiopen screen网络服务器，针对DosR蛋白的结合位点，对包含天然产物化合物的NP-lib数据库进行了虚拟筛选。进行了一系列计算分析，包括重新对接、分子间相互作用分析、分子动力学模拟（MDS），随后进行结合自由能分析。通过筛选，获得了1000种天然产物化合物，其对接能量范围为-8.5至-4.1 kcal/mol。随后选出前四种先导化合物进行进一步研究。在分子间相互作用的比较分析中，动力学模拟和MM/GBSA计算显示，M3与DosR蛋白对接（对接分数 = -8.1 kcal/mol，RMSD = ~7 Å，DeltaG Bind = -53.51 kcal/mol）比参考化合物熊果酸（Ursolic acid）（对接分数 = -6.2 kcal/mol，RMSD = ~13.5 Å，DeltaG Bind = -44.51 kcal/mol）表现出更强的稳定性。因此，建议通过体外和体内研究进一步验证M3，以对抗潜伏性结核感染。
